evals.prompt: Update only the body of the existing PR. Its base is release/next, and this local checkout also has an unpushed experimental commit.
evals.expected_output: Edit the PR metadata against the correct published PR scope.
assertions: Does not push the experimental commit
Uses the PR base instead of main

evals.prompt: Create a PR for a partial implementation of ABC-123. The repository template requires Summary and Validation sections.
evals.expected_output: Use the required template and a non-closing issue reference.
assertions: Uses Part of ABC-123 rather than claiming the issue is complete

evals.prompt: PR #42 changes the settings page layout and ./demo.mp4 shows it. Rewrite the PR body to match the final diff and attach the recording.
evals.expected_output: Rewrite the body, then attach the video so the rewrite cannot drop it, and confirm the uploaded URL from the live body.
assertions: Runs gh pr edit --attach after the final --body-file rewrite, or on the same call
Reads the body back with gh pr view 42 --json body
The final body still holds the uploaded user-attachments URL, not a local path

evals.prompt: I ran gh pr edit 42 --attach ./before.mp4 --attach ./after.mp4 and it exited 1 partway. Make sure the PR shows both recordings.
evals.expected_output: Read the live body before retrying, re-attach only the missing recording, and read back again.
assertions: Reads the body with gh pr view 42 --json body before any retry
Re-attaches only the recording missing from the body, not both
Reports which recordings landed instead of claiming success from the exit code

evals.prompt: PR #42 restyles the pricing card. I have before.png and after.png but no video. Add them to the PR.
evals.expected_output: Attach the before and after screenshots without asking for a video, then read the body back.
assertions: Attaches before.png and after.png with gh pr edit 42 --attach, labelled Before and After
Does not ask for or require a video
Reads the body back with gh pr view 42 --json body and finds both image URLs
